4279-6094-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:

4279-6094-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

824-2728-6012-6797.easyPrerequisites:

When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.

Resolve each Scute Swarm trigger, creating that many creature tokens.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.

Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4089-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.
